name: Honda XR600R
engine: 591 cc air-cooled four-valve single, carb, kick start
intro: The big air-cooled XR. Kick start only, with a decompression lever you need to use.

H: Air-cooled Honda singles need the valve clearance checked often. A tight exhaust valve is the usual cause of hard starting.
B: Find top dead center with the decompression lever before you kick. A big single can kick back hard.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
